title: AMD Strix Halo RDMA Cluster Setup Guide
summary: A technical setup guide for configuring RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access) clusters using AMD Strix Halo APUs, enabling low-latency high-bandwidth networking for distributed AI inference and HPC workloads.
problem_solved: Provides step-by-step instructions for setting up RDMA networking infrastructure to enable efficient distributed computing across multiple AMD Strix Halo nodes.
why_valuable: Enables researchers and developers to build cost-effective AI/HPC clusters using AMD's integrated APU design with enterprise-grade RDMA for distributed inference.
